status: Frozen before new release outcomes or external numeric values are evaluated
design_status: Exploratory redesign motivated by observed row-release failure; calibration-only projected variance was examined for the two existing synthetic schemas
output_object: Numerical column totals and equivalent means; not a replacement row-level microdata table

public_external_dataset.name: UCI Concrete Compressive Strength
public_external_dataset.recipe_grouping: All records with identical eight-feature recipes stay in the same block and calibration/release partition

task_weights: Equal weights over all numerical means; no field selected after evaluating outcomes
postprocessing: Same fixed public range-weighted linear equality projection for all strategies; final public-bound clipping also reported separately
primary: Expected calibration-normalized projected squared error and empirical mean of that error over all seeds; analytical expression includes any common projection bias
secondary: absolute relative error for each field
uncertainty: Within-dataset P10/P90 seed ranges; paired differences and bootstrap intervals; between-dataset summaries separated from within-dataset noise. Independent generated pairs are not external generalization. One external public dataset is not independent-user or confidential deployment evidence.
privacy: Trusted centralized processing, fixed public roster, one row per unit, replace-one adjacency. Independent fixed calibration parameters. Pure DP column-sum sensitivity is U-L, not n*(U-L). Field epsilons sum to the total. Reproducibility mode on synthetic/public inputs only. No production authorization path added.
fairness: Uniform and optimized strategies use the identical aggregate task, mechanism, public bounds, projection, clipping and paired noise draws. No aggregate-versus-microdata superiority ranking.
failures: All failures and all seeds retained; no hidden retries or output overwriting
